operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single cost center by id. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page or format flag. For this endpoint it has no visible effect, so `/cost_center/{ID}` and `/cost_center/{ID}/1` return the same result.

The successful response is a **flat object** of the cost center's fields (it is not wrapped in a `data` envelope).

`is_primary` is:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) cost center |
| 0 | Secondary (child) cost center |

`cost_center_id` is the id of the parent cost center (`0` for a primary/root cost center), and `cost_center_ids` is the comma-separated ancestor path.

Note: requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened` rather than a 404.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The id of the cost center to fetch.

200.description: The cost center, returned as a flat object.

schema.description: A single cost-center record, returned flat (not wrapped).

code.description: Cost center code. Unique across the account.

is_primary.description:
Whether this is a primary (root) cost center.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) |
| 0 | Secondary (child) |

cost_center_id.description: Id of the parent cost center. `0` for a primary/root cost center.

cost_center_ids.description: Comma-separated ancestor path of parent cost-center ids.

branch_id.description: Id of the branch the cost center belongs to.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

500.description: Requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened`.

schema.description: Plain-text body `error happened`. Currently returned when the requested id does not exist (rather than a 404).
